decisions.reason: The construction site dumper was only mentioned on the website and there is no performance evidence since 2019, but it fits the firm's vehicle know-how and costs little to keep, so it stays despite above-average uncertainty.

The inclined furniture lift line is presented on its own page and draws on the firm's core lifting and service strengths, so with no sign of a shortfall against aspirations there is no reason for problemistic search.
The building material lift line shares technology, parts and service with the furniture lifts and serves steady construction demand, so it likely meets aspirations and is kept.

The truck-mounted variant is a single model with a narrower market, which makes it somewhat more exposed, but it complements the lift family and slack from the exited mining lines allows the firm to carry it.
